The patent most likely names Irving Langmuir, Schaefer's long-time GE collaborator, but I could not verify the patent record, so this is a judgment from the known collaboration rather than a confirmed fact. Katharine B. Blodgett, the other candidate, is also a GE colleague, but nothing I know links her to a mechanical-expansion indicator. A search of the patent database for the title and inventor would settle it.
CONFIDENCE: 35
